description: The opening cutscene in the captain's quarters has played.
Blackbeard has had his morning briefing with Mister Hale.
The Captain's Key has been taken from the desk drawer.
Mags and Quill's argument about the stores has played.
The first descent into the rat-infested cargo hold has played.
The battle tutorial about timed hits has been shown.
Quill has briefed the captain about the rats.
The Rats in the Hold quest is finished.
The Captain's Rounds quest is finished.
The captain has inspected the hoard during his rounds.
Both prologue quests are done; the ship is free to explore.
The captain rang the ship's bell for no reason at all.
The captain has rested in his bed at least once (shows the tip once).
Old Finch has mentioned his lost sea-chest key.
Finch's rusty key has been returned and his chest opened.
Brask has his cannon fuse back.
The captain has won a sparring match against the crew.
Mags has slipped the captain a biscuit for the rat hunt.
